title: neottopteris grevillei
intro: Neottopteris grevillei, commonly known as the Greville's moonwort or the moon fern, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antipyretic properties. The bioactive constituents of Neottopteris grevillei include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory activities. The therapeutic actions of Neottopteris grevillei include pain relief, wound healing, and fever reduction, making it a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
